request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:WINDMILL

layers.text: Change only two things. The red roofs (the cone roof and the small roof over the door) become near-black charcoal slate (#2b2b31), with no red or brown left. The stone walls of the round tower become a lighter slate blue-grey (#8b92a3) with a mid-grey shade (#6a7082), clearly lighter than the roofs and sails. Keep the four ragged grey sails, the violet windows, the door, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
